text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Tenno Sho is my—
and indeed, my family's—cherished ambition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: On my pride as one born to the Mejiro family, I shall surely claim the honor of the Shield!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
